Title: 🔴 EPIC 1: Security & Compliance Hardening
Body:
Address critical security vulnerabilities before production deployment. Blocks all other work.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All CRITICAL and HIGH vulnerabilities resolved
- Security audit passed
- Penetration testing completed

**Estimated Effort:** 3-4 weeks

Title: 🧪 EPIC 2: Comprehensive Testing Strategy
Body:
Establish robust testing coverage including unit, integration, E2E, security, and performance tests. Target: 80%+ coverage.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 80%+ code coverage
- All critical paths tested
- CI/CD integration

**Estimated Effort:** 4-6 weeks

Title: 📚 EPIC 3: Documentation Completeness
Body:
Complete documentation for user guides, API docs, architecture docs, runbooks, and onboarding materials.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- User documentation complete
- API documentation complete
- Developer onboarding guide
- Operations runbooks

**Estimated Effort:** 2-3 weeks

Title: 🏗️ EPIC 4: Core Platform Features
Body:
Complete core platform functionality: site generation, admin CRUD, multi-page support, lead management.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Multi-page site generation
- Full admin CRUD
- Lead management system

**Estimated Effort:** 6-8 weeks

Title: 🎨 EPIC 5: Generated Site Features
Body:
Enhance generated sites with booking, contact forms, SEO, and media capabilities.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Online booking integration
- Contact form submissions
- SEO structured data
- Image upload system

**Estimated Effort:** 4-6 weeks

Title: 📢 EPIC 6: Outreach & Customer Onboarding
Body:
Build outreach pipeline, WhatsApp integration, customer onboarding flow, and CRM-lite.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- WhatsApp outreach templates
- Customer onboarding form
- Lead status pipeline

**Estimated Effort:** 4-5 weeks

Title: 💳 EPIC 7: Payments & Monetization
Body:
Integrate MercadoPago, subscription management, feature gating by tier.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- MercadoPago integration
- Subscription management
- Pricing tiers implemented

**Estimated Effort:** 3-4 weeks
